systems.system: Système informatisé de gestion de l'état civil (SIGEC)
systems.platform: a software solution for entry, transmission and use of civil-status data; not named
systems.owner: Ville de Djibouti (Mairie), with a SIGEC administrator and team
systems.tiers: the civil-status centres of the communes of Djibouti city, in use since 2011; existing registers digitised and indexed at set-up

note: The system is the capital city's own civil-registration application, an 'application' system and so no fact for the connection sub-indicator; the document says nothing of how the civil-status centres are connected. A diagnostic mission under PROGOUV began on 28 April 2024.
